## How to sign

**Signing is a one-time action per contributor.**

In your first pull request, add a line to [`CONTRIBUTORS.md`](../CONTRIBUTORS.md)
in this form and check the CLA box in the PR template:

```
- Your Name <your@email> — signed CLA v1.0 on YYYY-MM-DD
```

Committing that line with your pull request constitutes your signature. It ties
the agreement to a verifiable git identity, which is the point.

## Why this exists

Dockstash is licensed under **AGPL-3.0-only** and always will be, for everyone.

Some organizations cannot use AGPL software for policy reasons, so the Maintainer
also offers Dockstash under a separate commercial license, and operates a managed
service at dockstash.com. Both require the ability to distribute the whole
codebase under terms other than the AGPL.

Copyright law does not permit relicensing code you do not own. Without this
agreement, a single external contribution would permanently block both — and
retrofitting consent later means tracking down every past contributor.

**What this does not do.** It does not let the Maintainer take the AGPL version
away. Every release that has shipped under AGPL-3.0 stays AGPL-3.0, and anyone
may fork it under that license. This agreement adds an option; it removes
nothing.

Questions before signing: **support@dockstash.com**.
